for_editor: Synonyms were compared ignoring the capital first letter that NIST gives every entry in its Other names list.
Street-name regions taken from US federal publishers (DEA, NIDA) are not stated on the pages themselves; they are confirmed here as the publisher's jurisdiction.
NIST's LSD page also tags six other names as street names: Acid, Cubes, Heavenly blue, Pearly gates, Royal blue, Wedding bells; none is cited in the file.
